| --------------- | --------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `files`         | `Array<object>` |          | `[]`                                   | Files to render. Each entry: `{ id?, name, size?, type?, url?, uploadedAt?, uploadedBy? }`. |
| `title`         | `string`        |          | `''`                                   | Optional widget title.                                                                      |
| `description`   | `string`        |          | `''`                                   | Optional description.                                                                       |
| `readOnly`      | `boolean`       |          | `false`                                | Hide the dropzone + delete actions.                                                         |
| `accept`        | `string`        |          | `''`                                   | `accept` attribute for the file input.                                                      |
| `multiple`      | `boolean`       |          | `true`                                 | Allow multi-file selection.                                                                 |
| `maxSizeMb`     | `number`        |          | `0`                                    | Per-file max size in megabytes. 0 disables.                                                 |
| `dropzoneLabel` | `string`        |          | `'Drop files here or click to browse'` | Dropzone primary label.                                                                     |
| `dropzoneHint`  | `string`        |          | `''`                                   | Dropzone secondary hint.                                                                    |
| `emptyLabel`    | `string`        |          | `'No files attached.'`                 | Empty-state text when files[] is empty.                                                     |
| `downloadLabel` | `string`        |          | `'Download'`                           | Download button label / title.                                                              |
| `deleteLabel`   | `string`        |          | `'Delete'`                             | Delete button label / title.                                                                |

### Events

| Name              | Payload | Description                                                                           |
| ----------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `upload-rejected` | —       | Emitted when one or more files in the batch exceed maxSizeMb.                         |
| `upload`          | —       | Emitted with the file batch from the dropzone or file picker.                         |
| `file-click`      | —       | Emitted on row click (not on the action buttons).                                     |
| `download`        | —       | Emitted when the Download button is clicked.                                          |
| `delete`          | —       | Emitted when the Delete button is clicked. Parent persists then removes from files[]. |
